Luethke etal 1988 · source review

Rechecked 16 October 2026. 19 numbered figures; 101 saved field/component observations; 13 added and 82 existing contours refined.

All specimens sharing a figure appear together. Checkbox labels identify saved views, not independent animals. Dashed orange outlines show the archived geometry from before this pass. Blank source pages retain the documented assessment; no contour is manufactured to close an open field.

Areas remain provisional anatomical interpretations. Partial components are labelled; comparative drawings and repeated views do not add animals. Source projections, sections and nonmetric schematics cannot establish unfolded cortical surface area.
